contracts.handoff: Each agent writes data/reports/<id>.json and only then marks its stage complete.
contracts.gates: A stage fails if any listed gate fails; the release agent will not ship.
contracts.inputs: public/js/core/town-data.js (real geography) is the single source of truth.

agents.name: Cartographer
agents.summary: Treats OpenStreetMap anchors as canon: streets, quarters, stations, borders.
agents.handoff: metric road network + rail chainage → Urbanist, Rail engineer

agents.name: Geologist
agents.summary: Builds the valley from EU-DEM 25 m samples, the Diddelengerbaach and the two summits.

agents.name: Urbanist
agents.summary: Cuts building lots along real streets, keeps the rail corridor and parks clear, balances density per quarter.
gates: no lot on the rail corridor
no lot inside parks or works core

agents.name: Architect
agents.summary: Gives every lot a style, roof, shopfront and window grid; furnishes the 17 visitable interiors.

agents.name: Rail engineer
agents.summary: Platforms, catenary, underpasses and the shuttle timetable between Bettembourg and Volmerange.
agents.handoff: station chainage + dwell timings → Systems, QA

agents.name: Retail & hospitality
agents.summary: Stocks the supermarkets with Luxembourgish products and writes the restaurant menus.

agents.name: Systems engineer
agents.summary: Deterministic world build, collision solver, save slots, HUD and the day/night clock.

agents.name: QA · gatekeeper
agents.summary: Fails the build on unreachable POIs, bad geometry, missing interiors or a blown performance budget.

agents.name: Release manager
agents.summary: Collects every report into docs/build-report.md and stamps the build.
